name: Veejay Lakshmi Engineering Works Limited
about: Veejay Lakshmi Engineering Works Limited manufactures and sells cotton yarn and knitted fabrics in India and internationally. It operates through two segments, Engineering and Textiles. The company offers textile machinery used for post-spinning operations, such as two-for-one twisters and random assembly winders, as well as related spare parts. It also operates windmills and rooftop solar panels. In addition, the company exports its products. Veejay Lakshmi Engineering Works Limited was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Coimbatore, India.
